Fallback: exact-name SVG files from JoseArroyave/football-logos at a pinned upstream commit under the repository's declared MIT license; source path and license notice are retained. Club marks can remain trademarks of their respective owners. Ambiguous or unresolved names use initials instead of a guessed crest.
